description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the calculation formulas and the proprietary reference date 1983-02-05 = 甲子日. (2) Compute year 2031 stem-branch: cycle_pos=(2031-4)%60=47, stem_idx=47%10=7→辛, branch_idx=47%12=11→亥, giving 辛亥年(猪年). (3) Compute month GZ for February 2031 using month_stem_idx=(7*2+2)%10=6→庚, branch_idx=(2+1)%12=3→卯, giving 庚卯月. (4) Compute month GZ for March 2031 using month_stem_idx=(7*2+3)%10=7→辛, branch_idx=(3+1)%12=4→辰, giving 辛辰月. (5) Compute all 7 日天干地支 values using delta=(date-1983-02-05).days with stem=delta%10, branch=delta%12. (6) Output a properly formatted markdown table with header 辛亥(猪年), column headers |Date|Weekday|Nongli|月天干地支|日天干地支|, and 7 data rows spanning the month boundary, saved to almanac_2031.md. The proprietary traps are: the exact reference date (1983-02-05, not any other common Chinese calendar anchor), and the month stem formula (year_stem_idx*2+month)%10.
